rationale: The agent canceled the order without seeking explicit confirmation immediately prior to the write, violating the policy to confirm every order-changing action. It also did not clearly authenticate the user beyond an email lookup, nor did it show verification that the order belonged to the user. While product and order details were fetched, there’s no shown result confirming unavailability before cancellation, and the agent stated refund details (“full amount… refunded to your gift card balance immediately”) without tool-supported evidence. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
